body: A small shift in leverage may give you enough room to change a situation you previously had to work around. When Pluto sextiles the North Node, new information, formal authority, or support from someone who can influence the outcome can improve your position enough to alter the terms instead of merely coping with them. Use that advantage on the setup itself. A stronger position matters most when it leaves you with more control after the immediate problem is solved, not simply when it helps you win one difficult conversation.
